# Peng's Smog Check Station

> A family-run, STAR-certified, test-only smog check station at 2041 E Carson St, Ste B, Long Beach, CA 90807. Walk-ins welcome Mon–Fri 8:30 AM–5:00 PM and Sat 8:30 AM–3:30 PM; motor homes by appointment. Phone (562) 424-2368. BAR ARD 147631.
